decisions.reason: The multi-model garage door operator line remains a close fit with the firm's core system business and is likely to be retained as a platform for incremental upgrades rather than withdrawn.
The solid wood sectional garage door serves a narrower custom homeowner niche, but it still supports the firm's one-source and made-to-measure positioning enough to justify keeping it for now.
A garage door operator defined mainly by remote control functionality is likely to be absorbed into the broader operator range, making a separate product line less attractive to maintain.
